[[File:Mira_baran_do_novice_robe.jpg|thumb|125px|[[Mira]] wearing a Baran Do Novice robe.]]
These '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]''' were worn by individuals who had just begun their training in the [[Baran Do]] philosophy. The Baran Do were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] race and had been advisors and seers to the leaders of Kel Dor society. Their philosophy centered on seeking inner peace and consulting with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] before making decisions.

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Appearance==
Baran Do Novice robes were much like [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], only the inside was more creamy and the outside was redder.

==Found==
These robes were easy to find. Most [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] traders sold these for around 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
